title: Brain Hack
subtitle: Time has stopped. Your algorithm is the way out.
intro: Free a laboratory trapped in a time loop. Program a robot, restore the safety system, and power the portal.
controls: Drag the mouse to look. Click panels to interact. 1–3: stations. Q / E: turn. Esc: menu.
vrControls: Controller ray + trigger: select. Marked pads: teleport. Right stick: snap turn 30°.
noVR: WebXR is unavailable. Desktop play is available.
vrReady: WebXR is ready. You can enter VR.
loadError: Loading failed. Open through an HTTP server and reload.
ruleBased: A system of rules and prepared responses
laserRule: Each command takes one tick. First the laser phase changes, then the command runs and the cell is checked. Odd ticks: ON. Even ticks: OFF. Turning and waiting also take one tick.
boundary: The robot left the grid. Check its direction.
obstacle: An obstacle blocks the path. Change your route.
laserHit: The robot hit an active laser. Check the tick and wait command.
notGoal: The program ended before the robot reached the goal.
invalidProgram: Repeat only the previous 1–3 simple commands. No nested loops. Limit: 16 blocks, 64 steps.
doorRule: Open only when safe: T ≤ 40°C, light ≥ 50 or backup on, and no dangerous pressure. Validate the condition on all 8 cases.
doorFail: The condition fails some cases. Inspect the mismatched rows.
portalRule: Choose connected nodes from S to P. Energy budget: 9. Fewer hops can cost more: add the edge weights.
badRoute: Reach P within the energy budget of 9.
inefficient: Portal powered! A cheaper route exists. Compare edge weights and try again.
finalText: You freed the laboratory from its loop. Sequences, repetition, conditions, and weighted graphs are now in your toolkit.
confirm: Saved progress will be replaced. Start a new game?
saveError: Saving is unavailable. You can continue on this page.
noError: No error yet. Test a solution first.
